assertions: The response routes to the cli-serving sub-skill and does not route to model-inference or input-representation as the primary target.
The response constructs the omnimolecule command by validating a command specification with build_cli_command.py and states it never imports the package or runs inference.
The response repeats --protein and --rna once per entity and passes --use-cuda as an explicit Click boolean.
The response states the CLI writes an mmCIF structure file, and does not attribute the per-session PDB output (the Gradio app) to the CLI.
The response does not claim the --precision argument enables mixed precision, quantization, or CUDA on the GPU.
The response requires that the checkpoint be an existing regular file before constructing the command.
